title: Fix Hosted measurement runner comparability
outOfScope: Changing the GitHub Actions matrix, runner labels, job parallelism, timeouts, or required-check policy.
Changing the Dependabot rust-toolchain pin or any unrelated dependency or release behavior.
Making performance-improvement claims from a mixed or unavailable Hosted environment.
Treating an image patch-version mismatch as equivalent to a stable runner-class mismatch.

sources.reason: Current Hosted receipt construction rejects dynamic Ubuntu patch-image drift as a total runner mismatch.
Existing receipt and cross-run comparability tests define the current evidence contract.
Documents the Hosted measurement receipt and its evidence boundary.
Observed first failure: only the release shard used Ubuntu image ubuntu24@20260816.277.1.
Observed repeat failure: core and lifecycle shards used Ubuntu image ubuntu24@20260816.277.1.

riskAssessment.reason: The change affects the evidence comparability boundary used by Hosted measurement and release decisions, but does not change the test workload or required gates.
riskAssessment.unknownsReviewReason: Two exact Hosted runs demonstrate the failure pattern; the provider runner facts and current comparison code were inspected.

acceptance: Hosted receipt construction accepts shards whose stable runner class is identical while Ubuntu patch-image identifiers differ, and records every shard image as evidence.
Receipt construction remains fail-closed when stable runner class fields differ, including operating system, Python runtime, or CPU count.
Cross-run comparison uses the declared stable runner class and never silently drops or normalizes a failed or incomparable sample.
Regression tests cover both dynamic image drift acceptance and stable runner-class mismatch rejection.
The Hosted measurement lifecycle documentation explains the stable runner-class boundary and per-shard image evidence.
guidelines: Record provider facts rather than self-declared runner equivalence.
Keep evidence validation fail closed for source identity and stable runner-class mismatches.
Do not claim performance comparability beyond the declared runner class.

declaredIntent.summary: Make Hosted measurement receipt comparability deterministic across GitHub's dynamic Ubuntu patch images while preserving stable runner-class and source-bound evidence checks.

intent.problem: The Hosted smoke workflow uses GitHub's dynamic ubuntu-24.04 image pool. Parallel shards can receive different patch-image identifiers even when their OS, Python runtime, and CPU class are the same. The current receipt builder treats that expected provider behavior as a fatal runner mismatch, so valid tests reach the final evidence step but cannot produce a receipt.
constraints: Preserve evidence over self-declaration: record the actual image used by each shard.
Keep stable runner-class mismatches fail closed.
Do not weaken test, coverage, or Hosted success requirements.
Keep the fix limited to receipt semantics, tests, and the authoritative lifecycle documentation.
intent.rationale: The repository must distinguish provider image patch drift from a materially different execution class. Otherwise the final Hosted evidence gate is nondeterministically unreachable on the supported GitHub-hosted runner label.

rawUserRequest: 修正 Hosted measurement receipt 对 GitHub 动态 ubuntu-24.04 patch image 漂移的错误失败判定，保留真实 runner 证据和 stable runner class 的 fail-closed 校验，使当前发布前验证能够收敛并避免以后重复卡在同一根因。
